serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Annoying neighbor: Calm down old man. 
Oh my~ Someone is confronting this bastard. I need to open my door a little to hear them better.
Alright, this should do. 
???: I’M TELLING ONCE AGAIN TO TURN IT OFF. I’M NOT PLAYING KID.
Annoying neighbor: And what are you gonna do, huh? Shit your pants geezer?!
???: I’M GONNA DO THIS!
‘This’? What is he talking about?
Annoying neighbor: C-calm down, ok? You want me to turn it off no problem.
???: GO INSIDE! RIGHT NOW!
Annoying neighbor: A-alright, just please, don’t shoot!
Shoot? Don’t tell me that angry guy pulled out a…
I need to close my door before that crazy guy realizes I heard everything!
???:...
They went inside the room, I only heard his screams, but nothing specific! Should I call the police? I definitely should call the police.
Quick! Where is my phone!
O-ok! Here it is! 
Police's TTS: Hello! You just contacted your local police department. We are sorry to inform you that this number has used up all of its constitutionally guaranteed free minutes on the police hotline. 
Police's TTS: Please, try again later. You can expand your time limit by buying one of our premium packages, the cheapest one starting at 39.99$ and…
You: I’M DONE!
Fuck… I said it  out loud… I hope this maniac didn’t hear me.
What am I supposed to do now?! I Just need to pay and then call, right?!
